entries.source: The various racial bonuses a character can have.
entries.target: 角色可能拥有的各种种族加成。

entries.source: Another of Garkul's heirlooms would bring out his spirit.
entries.target: 另一件加库尔的遗物将唤醒他的英灵。

entries.source: #VIOLET# The decrepit stairs crumble some more as you climb them.
entries.target: #VIOLET# 当你爬上这些破旧的楼梯的时候，它摇摇欲坠，又更加破碎了一点。

entries.source: There is no portal to activate here.
entries.target: 这里没有可用的传送门。
#ORCHID#以太渗透保护 %s 抵消了驱散！

entries.source: You must be able to move to use this talent.
entries.target: 你必须处于可以移动的状态才能使用该技能。
暴击时 枯萎溅射伤害

entries.source: Clear and slightly thicker than water. It froths when shaken.
entries.target: 龙涎比水更加粘稠，和水一样清澈，当你摇晃它时会有泡沫产生。

entries.source: A formless terror that seems to cut through the air, and its victims, like a knife.
entries.target: 这只形态模糊的恐魔，将敌人连同周围的空气一起切成两半。

entries.source: #ROYAL_BLUE#The golem decides to change it's name to #{bold}#%s#{normal}#.
You somehow fail to set the corrosive seed.

entries.target: 真正的%s... 或者%s这样说。

entries.source: You fade from sight, making you invulnerable until the beginning of your next turn.
entries.target: 你从视线中消失并无敌，直到下一回合开始。

entries.source: This door seems to be sealed.
You cannot take out more points!
Looks much like any other rock, though this one was recently sentient and trying to murder you.
entries.target: 它看起来和其他石头没什么两样，只不过这块不久前还具有意识，并且曾试图杀死你。

entries.source: You cannot do that on the world map.
entries.target: 你在世界地图上不能这样做。
